subject: MAP & contracting plan for Tangible Health — roles, redlines, milestones
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@tangiblehealth.com>, procurement@tangiblehealth.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-15T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: MAP & contracting plan for Tangible Health — roles, redlines, milestones

Hi Anna / TH procurement team,

Thanks again for the demo last week — great conversation. As discussed, I wanted to kick off a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) so we have a shared timeline and a single place to track owners for procurement and legal reviews. Attached is a one-page MAP (Redwood_MAP_TangibleHealth_v1.xlsx) and a preliminary SOW (SOW_v0.2.pdf) to provide context for contracting.

High-level ask: can you confirm who will own procurement + the legal redline at Tangible Health, and whether you prefer a tracked redline of the MSA or consolidated comments?

Suggested milestones (we can adjust):
- MAP shared: today (Aug 15) — see attached worksheet
- Procurement review & Qs: Aug 18
- Legal redline window: Aug 19–Aug 25
- Final sign target: Sep 1

If you can ping the internal owners (names + emails) we’ll add them to the MAP and loop in our legal (Rishi) and solutions (Marissa) to ensure any technical SOW clarifications are handled quickly.

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_TangibleHealth_v1.xlsx, SOW_v0.2.pdf

Next step: if you confirm owners here I’ll send a brief version of the MAP as a living Google sheet and repo the MSA in DocuSign for redlines.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0183

--
Redwood Inference — production-first inference for LLMs
From: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@tangiblehealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@tangiblehealth.com, Ben Kline <ben.k@tangiblehealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-15T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP & contracting plan for Tangible Health — roles, redlines, milestones

Thanks Karthik — looping in the right folks.

Procurement owner: Anna Lopez (me) — procurement@tangiblehealth.com
Legal / redline owner: Ben Kline (ben.k@tangiblehealth.com) — Ben will own the first pass of the MSA redlines.

We prefer a tracked redline for the MSA (helps our counsel speed review). Target for our internal review: return redlines within 5 business days after we receive the MSA draft. For the SOW, we can provide consolidated comments in one PDF to keep things tidy.

A couple of immediate Qs from Ben:
- Can you confirm data residency options and whether the MSA will include the standard security appendix?
- Any non-standard indemnity or export-control language we should expect?

I’ll add Ben to the MAP and we’ll aim to get the first redline to you by Aug 24 (unless we need more time after legal has the draft).

Best,
Anna Lopez
Director, Strategic Procurement
Tangible Health
anna.lopez@tangiblehealth.com | (617) 555-4422

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-16T11:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP & contracting plan for Tangible Health — roles, redlines, milestones

Hi Anna / Ben — thanks for the quick reply and for confirming owners. Adding a couple of Redwood contacts so you have direct points of contact:
- Rishi Malhotra (Legal) — rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
- Monica Patel (Solutions / SOW owner) — monica_patel@redwood.com

Rishi will handle MSA questions and we are happy to provide either a tracked redline or consolidated comments — whichever your counsel prefers. For transparency, our standard cadence for this type of deal is below; please tell us what works for you and we’ll update the MAP accordingly: 

Proposed contracting milestones (Redwood):
- Send Redwood MSA draft to Tangible Health: Aug 16 (attached: Redwood_MSA_draft.docx)
- Tangible Health legal redline period: Aug 17–Aug 24 (5 business days)
- Redwood review of redlines and rebuttal: Aug 25–Aug 27
- Finalize SOW edits and sign by Sep 1 (DocuSign route)

We’ve attached the MSA draft and SOW v0.2 for your review. If you prefer, I can also provide the MSA in DocuSign with an initial signature block so Ben can produce a tracked redline in Word — just let me know.

Security/data residency note: Rishi — Anna asked about data residency and security appendix. Our standard MSA includes a security appendix with options for US-only data handling; we can make that explicit in the SOW if Tangible Health requires. If you could confirm availability for a 30-min call this week to cover any security-specific clauses that would be helpful.

Attachments: Redwood_MSA_draft.docx, SOW_v0.2.pdf

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0199

Thanks all — timeline looks good. We will aim to return tracked redlines on the MSA by EOD Aug 24; consolidated SOW comments by Aug 20. A couple of items to note for Rishi / Redwood legal:
- Data residency: Tangible Health requires US-only data storage for PHI-adjacent workloads — we will flag any gaps in the security appendix.
- Liability / indemnity: we have a couple of standard edits; we’ll surface them in the redline.

If it helps, I can kick off a 30-min legal sync on Aug 21 — Rishi, would you and/or someone from your security team be available?

Thanks — Ben

ben.k@tangiblehealth.com | (617) 555-0100
